description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing BC-based chain offering a self-serve individual hot pot experience with over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 18 broths and dry mixes. The Kerrisdale location sits on West 41st Avenue and is part of a network that spans Metro Vancouver and beyond. Diners cook their own selection of premium meats, seafood, and vegetables in flavourful broths ranging from Signature Mala to vegan-friendly Tomato.
